offerings.title: API Audit
offerings.tagline: Find what is slowing your API down and fix it.
offerings.description: A structured diagnostic covering design consistency, performance bottlenecks, error handling, auth patterns, and documentation gaps. You get a prioritised report with clear, actionable recommendations — not a list of opinions.
deliverables: Prioritised fix list with effort estimates
offerings.goodFor: Teams with a production API that has reliability or performance problems they cannot get on top of.

offerings.title: API Architecture
offerings.tagline: Get the design right before it costs you to change it.
offerings.description: Collaborative API design from resource modelling and versioning strategy through to auth patterns and error contracts. Delivered as a spec your team can build from with confidence.
offerings.goodFor: Teams starting a new API or refactoring ahead of a major release.

offerings.title: Engineering Leadership
offerings.tagline: Practical support for managers and technical leads.
offerings.description: Ongoing advisory covering career frameworks, 1:1 structures, performance calibration, hiring, and team health. Regular sessions, async access, and practical tooling including a ready-to-use engineering career framework.
offerings.goodFor: Engineering managers, tech leads stepping up, or founders building their first engineering team.

offerings.title: Technical Discovery
offerings.tagline: A senior perspective on a specific problem, quickly.
offerings.description: A focused short-term engagement for a specific technical challenge. Architecture decision, stack choice, scaling concern, or incident post-mortem. Outside perspective without a long commitment.
offerings.goodFor: Teams at a technical crossroads who need a senior perspective fast.

process.title: Discovery call
process.desc: 30 minutes, no charge. We work out whether there is a fit and what the right engagement looks like.

process.title: Scoped proposal
process.desc: A clear written proposal covering scope, deliverables, timeline, and cost. No surprises.

process.title: Engagement
process.desc: Focused work with regular check-ins. Direct access throughout, no account managers in the way.

process.title: Delivery and debrief
process.desc: Written deliverables and a recorded walkthrough so the whole team can reference the outcome.
